about.heading: THE PERSON BEHIND CREATIVSTAN
about.title: HI. I'M SHARDULI.
paragraphs: I'm a digital creator who loves turning ideas into things people want to see, share and remember.
I work across posters, invitations, reels, advertisements, branding and AI-assisted creative work. Creativstan is where I bring all of that together - one project, one idea and one design at a time.

features.title: Personal
features.description: Every project is created around your idea.

features.title: Fast
features.description: Quick turnaround when you need it.

services.heading: SERVICES
services.subtitle: Whether you're celebrating something special or building a brand, I create visuals designed to make people stop, look and remember.
services.customNote: Every project doesn't fit into a package. Tell me what you're imagining and we'll figure out the right way to create it.
